test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-prod-gsm-qa-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"

echo "QA_SHA=4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight

echo "QA_SHA=4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
